label: pairwise_style_pack_character_design_001
resolved_prompt: Compose one continuous single-view vertical image built around exactly one clearly adult woman as the only figure. Every visible face, body, and hand belongs to this same woman. Keep a clean margin above her complete crown and keep both eyes clearly readable. Keep the complete crown, both eyes, and every body landmark named by the requested camera direction inside the image. The second character-design direction is the measured axis. Put its named face geometry, proportions, layers, seams, and closures on the visible subject. Photorealistic adult editorial treatment: angular shadow planes and repeated diagonal divisions around the subject. Use an amber-lit side and blue-shadowed side across subject and backdrop, powdery matte grain across midtones and backdrop with absorbed highlights, upward beams, rising forms, and restrained ceremonial glints, and hard separated silhouette and shadow edges with few controlled breaks. Combine it coherently with this second visual direction: An adult character has an asymmetric urban silhouette with offset layers and a clear uninterrupted body line, a diamond-shaped adult face with defined cheek planes and a compact chin, and grounded adult proportions with a broad torso, sturdy limbs, and stable weight distribution. The design is unified by subtle botanical seam curves and leaflike closures used as controlled accents. Resolve both directions on the same adult subject. Give every named visual cue an obvious, concrete location on the face, clothing, silhouette, lighting, or environment. Preserve the selected medium and keep the face, eyes, visible hands, joints, garment construction, and spatial relationships coherent. Finish the single scene cleanly with text-free, logo-free, watermark-free imagery.
